s6-painter.desc: a young visitor at the screens

s6-screen-wiper.desc: a man with a long cloth

three-dots-on-the-corner.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} stands at the front screens at the start of shift.

three-dots-on-the-corner.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} reads down the row of six wanted posters.

three-dots-on-the-corner.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} points at three orange dots on the corner of poster 4.

three-dots-on-the-corner.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} walks to the supply cabinet behind the desk.

three-dots-on-the-corner.1.5.line: {desk-sergeant} carries a cloth back to the screens.

wiper-at-dawn.1.1.line: {s6-screen-wiper} comes into the station hall at dawn with a long cloth.

wiper-at-dawn.1.2.line: {s6-screen-wiper} stands at the lower edge of the screens.

wiper-at-dawn.1.3.line: {s6-screen-wiper} runs the long cloth along posters 5 and 6.

wiper-at-dawn.1.4.line: {s6-screen-wiper} folds the cloth over {s6-screen-wiper.his} shoulder and leaves the hall.

cuffs-at-the-screens.1.1.line: {s6-painter} enters the station hall before dawn, orange paint smudged on both wrists.

cuffs-at-the-screens.1.2.line: {s6-painter} stands in front of poster 4, close to the glass.

cuffs-at-the-screens.1.3.line: {s6-painter} leaves the hall with a flat bag under one arm, a blue bot sticker on it.

poster-4-smeared.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} reads poster 4: orange paint is spread across the face.

poster-4-smeared.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the other five posters, all of them clean.

poster-4-smeared.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} argues with {extra:visitor} about who locked the hall overnight.

poster-4-smeared.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} walks back to the front desk.

poster-4-covered.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} reads poster 4: orange from edge to edge, the caption gone under it.

poster-4-covered.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the covered screen for the hall to see.

poster-4-covered.1.3.line: Posted to the mesh by {desk-sergeant}: "Screen 4 offline."

poster-4-covered.1.4.line: {extra:visitor} stands at the glass with one hand on the edge of the screen.

prints-and-a-dripping-drone.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} stands looking down at the floor below poster 4.

prints-and-a-dripping-drone.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at small orange sneaker prints, four steps from the door.

prints-and-a-dripping-drone.1.3.line: A cleaning drone passes an arm over the top of poster 2 while {desk-sergeant} watches.

prints-and-a-dripping-drone.1.4.line: The drone leaves a trail of orange drops down the glass past {desk-sergeant}.

comm-call-at-the-lift.1.1.line: {s6-painter} stands in the lift hall, waiting for the lift.

comm-call-at-the-lift.1.2.line: {s6-painter} on the comm, one side: "My sibling is not like the poster. Not like that."

comm-call-at-the-lift.1.3.line: {s6-painter} steps into the lift as the doors open.

comm-call-at-the-lift.1.4.line: {s6-painter} rides the lift up and out of the lobby.

can-in-the-bin-and-a-work-card.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} lifts a flat spray can out of the bin by the screens.

can-in-the-bin-and-a-work-card.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} turns the can over: a blue bot sticker on its side.

can-in-the-bin-and-a-work-card.1.3.line: {s6-screen-wiper} stands at the glass at dawn with a long cloth.

can-in-the-bin-and-a-work-card.1.4.line: {s6-screen-wiper} takes a work card from a pocket and hands it to {desk-sergeant}.

can-in-the-bin-and-a-work-card.1.5.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the card: "Contract cleaner, front screens."

lanyard-at-the-screens.1.1.line: {s6-painter} comes into the station hall early, hands in pockets.

lanyard-at-the-screens.1.2.line: {s6-painter} stands at poster 4 and looks at the orange-covered glass.

lanyard-at-the-screens.1.3.line: {s6-painter} turns a lanyard over: its printed surname matches the one in the caption of poster 4.

lanyard-at-the-screens.1.4.line: A drone docks on the ceiling rail above {desk-sergeant}, a label on its tank: "Orange sealant."

lanyard-at-the-screens.1.5.line: {s6-painter} leaves the hall without looking back.

poster-4-restored.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} carries a fresh print of poster 4 to the screens.

poster-4-restored.1.2.line: Posted to the mesh by {desk-sergeant}: "Poster 4 reprinted. Screen 4 back online."

poster-4-restored.1.3.line: {s6-painter} stands at the glass with the lanyard turned out.

poster-4-restored.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} talks with {s6-painter} at the glass for two minutes.

poster-4-restored.1.5.line: {s6-painter} hands {desk-sergeant} the flat bag with the blue bot sticker.

night-watch-at-the-screens.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands in a corner of the station hall, eyes on the screens.

night-watch-at-the-screens.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks up to the screens and stands close to the glass.

night-watch-at-the-screens.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} argues with {night-stakeout-officer} about overtime: "Two more nights, then I sign nothing."

night-watch-at-the-screens.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} reads down all six posters, every one of them clean.

hours-at-the-screens.1.1.line: {s6-painter} hands {desk-sergeant} a signed sheet for cleaning hours at the screens.

hours-at-the-screens.1.2.line: {s6-painter} carries a broom and a bucket to the screens.

hours-at-the-screens.1.3.line: {s6-painter} works along the glass with the broom and bucket.

hours-at-the-screens.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} runs a scan at the hall door with the handheld.
